description: Portrait Monitor profile keeps process names, CPU and memory visible at 15pt; live profile launched by Sway IPC for validation before image integration.
provenance_note: Operator-declared metadata does not prove that footage shows a real touch.

site_assets.video_transform: Camera presentation rotated180 degrees, limited-range H264/yuv420p, realtime; original retained.
site_assets.screenshot_source: Grim on physical board transferred over serial

review.outcome: Single-column meters and PID/CPU%/MEM%/Command display readable process names at15pt.
review.limitations: Live HTOPRC launched through Sway IPC; new image/menu integration pending. Capture sampler adds CPU load, so shown CPU values are not idle-performance measurements.
review.native_capture: Sampled Wayland screencopy with measured monotonic intervals; not smoothness or finger accuracy proof.
